title: Hazel and the Garden Revisited
author: Coral Reyes
blurb: Ivo Ravensworth, a royal food-taster building immunity one dish at a time, knows every smuggler's road through the Thornfell mountains. But when the old gods begin answering prayers again, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must find the door out of a country that no longer exists, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
